title: WI-14 cross-WI integration and final regression
rawUserRequest: 对请仔细验收，每个WI的对应状况。起码我对性能改善和Outcome感觉是有疑问的。outcome不是没有report是没有交付到对话框里。

declaredIntent.summary: Independently reconcile every WI-04 through WI-13 acceptance result, with special evidence checks for performance improvement and Outcome delivery to the conversation UI.

outOfScope: Changing existing archived Work Item evidence or collision receipts
Changing runtime, scheduler, provider, CI, network, cache, or execution policy behavior
Changing WI-00 through WI-13 implementation semantics
Opening, closing, or modifying external Issues or Pull Requests
Making causal performance, adoption-readiness, or human-receipt claims

sources.reason: Immutable archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, and manifest evidence for WI-04 through WI-13.
WI-07 evidence classification and reuse boundary.
WI-12 evidence-only performance diagnosis and explicit limitations.
WI-05 direct Outcome handoff and persisted report pipeline.
WI-05 regression evidence for direct handoff and projections.
Agent-wide requirement to relay each Outcome to the human conversation.

riskAssessment.reason: The integration report must compare immutable evidence across ten Work Items and fail closed when identity, status, or projection evidence is incomplete.

reasons: Cross-WI evidence reconciliation and final regression require strict verification.

executionDecision.reason: The report is repository-local, read-only over archived evidence, deterministic, and advisory-only.

preReviewWarnings: Outcome delivery is verified as repository stdout/projection evidence only; UI conversation receipt remains outside repository proof.
Performance status must distinguish measured evidence from unknown causal improvement and must not report an optimization result without a comparable baseline.
All archived Work Item identities and status colors must be checked; a malformed or mismatched archive is a red fail-closed result.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The report discovers and validates exactly the required WI-04 through WI-13 successor/archive identities, including Contract/Summary/Outcome/manifest presence, matching workItemId, status, and humanStatusColor.

The report produces deterministic JSON and Markdown with a stable source digest, sorted Work Item rows, explicit overall status, limitations, and decisionImpact=none; malformed, missing, cross-identity, or mismatched evidence yields red fail-closed output.

The report cross-checks WI-04 cost-metric limitations, WI-05 Outcome direct-handoff/projection evidence, WI-06 status interface, WI-07 foundation plus WI-08/09/10 policy reuse, WI-11 governance effect, WI-12 performance diagnosis, and WI-13 adoption reality without rewriting their archives.

Outcome delivery is explicitly accepted only when the persisted Outcome, task_report JSON/Markdown pair, and tested direct CLI handoff are present; every Outcome section is preserved per WI, and the report records that a UI conversation receipt cannot be proven by repository artifacts alone.

Every agent completion must be relayed by the owning agent or orchestrator into the human conversation with a visible traffic-light marker and concise Outcome facts; file existence alone is not accepted as delivery.

Performance is explicitly accepted only as measured diagnosis/advisory evidence; absent comparable before/after baseline, the report must state that runtime performance improvement is unverified and must not infer causality.
Focused TDD tests cover green, warning/unknown, red/malformed, deterministic digest, archive identity, Outcome projection, and performance no-overclaim scenarios.
Documentation describes the command, evidence contract, per-WI verdicts, Outcome boundary, performance boundary, and rerun guidance.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All required archives, outcomes, and projection evidence are present and internally consistent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report is green only when every required Work Item passes identity/status checks and no unresolved limitation affects the integration verdict.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused complete-fixture integration test and CLI JSON/Markdown validation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Archives are complete but one or more Work Items carry completed_with_warnings, explicit unknowns, or Outcome UI-receipt limitations.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report is yellow, preserves each limitation, and does not claim performance improvement, adoption readiness, or human dialog receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused warning fixture covering WI-04/WI-12 and WI-05 projection boundary.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A required archive, Outcome, identity, binding, or projection is missing, malformed, or mismatched.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report is red and fail-closed with the exact source defect; it never falls back to green or inferred completion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused malformed, missing, cross-task, and digest mismatch tests.

guidelines: Read archived evidence only; never mutate or reinterpret immutable WI-00 through WI-13 archives.
Use deterministic sorted serialization and source digests; do not include wall-clock timestamps in the fact digest.
Keep the integration report advisory-only with decisionImpact=none; do not change gates, runtime behavior, scheduling, or trust decisions.
Preserve unknown, warning, external-responsibility, and human-receipt boundaries in both JSON and Markdown.
Document every new public function and use standard-library-only implementation code.
Every agent completion must be relayed by the owning agent or orchestrator into the human conversation with a visible traffic-light marker and concise Outcome facts.

intent.problem: The individual WI archives now exist, but their combined status, Outcome delivery, and performance claims have not been independently reconciled in one deterministic final gate.
constraints: Treat archived evidence as immutable and inspect only repository-local files.
Do not claim that strict verification throughput or runtime execution became faster without comparable measured evidence.
Do not claim the assistant UI received an Outcome merely because a CLI stream or Markdown file exists.
Keep all findings advisory and fail closed for malformed or mismatched evidence.
intent.rationale: A final cross-WI report gives the user a per-WI acceptance record and makes the two disputed areas—performance and Outcome delivery—explicitly evidence-bound rather than inferred from successful merges.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized complete WI-14 execution and careful acceptance of every prior WI.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
